title: Mary and Martha
description: Jesus arrives in a village where Martha welcomes him into her home. Her sister Mary sits at the Lord's feet and listens to his words, while Martha is busy with all she has to do. Martha complains to Jesus that her sister has left her alone to serve, and asks him to tell Mary to help her. Jesus answers: "Martha, Martha, you are worried and upset about many things. But only one thing is necessary. Mary has chosen the good portion, and it will not be taken from her."
